doc.title: Bob Haggart interviewed by Michael Woods, Clinton, New York, September 22, 1995

title: Young players carrying on classic jazz
summary: Praise for Dan Barrett, Jon-Erik Kellso, Howard Alden, Harry Allen and Ken Peplowski for playing swing rather than bebop.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Is jazz healthy? Young players, rock and the future

blocks.x: Do you think that’s trying to send a —

They’re sort of carrying it on, you know, and we’re very lucky to have those guys, I’m talking about Dan Barrett and Jon-Erik Kellso, and Howard Alden on the guitar. These guys are all in their — Harry Allen, tenor sax, Ken Peplowski. They’re all getting a name for themselves as they’re marvelous players, and they’re not playing bebop. They’re going earlier than bebop. In other words, it’s like swing — classic jazz, as they say.
